name: @cloudradial/ucp-mcp
description: MCP server for the CloudRadial UCP Portal — exposes the CloudRadial API V2 as MCP tools for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and other MCP clients.

scripts.test: esbuild test/tools.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/test/tools.test.mjs --log-level=warning && node dist/test/tools.test.mjs && node ../cloudradial-ucp/scripts/check-skills.mjs && esbuild test/secure-setup.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/test/secure-setup.test.mjs --log-level=warning && node --test dist/test/secure-setup.test.mjs
